frighten away customers: The loud construction work next door may frighten away customers who come to the restaurant for a quiet meal.
隔壁吵雜的施工可能會嚇跑那些來餐廳享受安靜用餐的顧客。
frighten someone into: The scammer tried to frighten the old man into paying by threatening that his son would go to prison.
詐騙犯威脅說老人的兒子會坐牢，試圖嚇得老人去付錢。
frighten the life out of: My brother hid behind the door and jumped out to frighten the life out of me when I came home.
我弟弟躲在門後，在我回家時跳出來，把我嚇得半死。
frown on gambling: Many traditional parents frown on gambling, so they never let their children play cards for money, even during holidays.
許多傳統父母不贊成賭博，所以即使是過年過節，也從不讓孩子玩牌賭錢。
frown at someone: The strict teacher frowned at him for the whole lesson after he arrived late again without an excuse.
那位嚴格的老師在他又無故遲到後，整堂課都對他皺眉。
be frowned upon: In Japan, talking loudly on the phone on trains is frowned upon, so most passengers stay quiet.
在日本，在火車上大聲講電話不被認同，所以大多數乘客都保持安靜。
frustrate a plan: A sudden typhoon may frustrate a plan that took months to prepare, so always have a backup date.
一場突如其來的颱風可能會阻撓花了好幾個月準備的計畫，所以務必準備一個備用日期。
be frustrated with: She was frustrated with the slow internet, which kept cutting off and ruining her online class.
她對網速慢感到挫折，網路不斷斷線，毀了她的線上課程。
frustrate one's efforts: Strong winds and high waves frustrated the rescuers' efforts to reach the fishing boat before night fell.
強風和巨浪使救難人員在入夜前抵達漁船的努力落空。
fuel speculation: The singer's sudden decision to cancel her tour fueled speculation that she was going to retire.
歌手突然決定取消巡演，助長了她即將退休的臆測。
fuel anger: The government's decision to raise bus fares again only fueled anger among workers who already earn very little.
政府再度調漲公車票價的決定，只激起了原本收入就很微薄的勞工的憤怒。
fuel growth: Strong sales of smartphones and computers helped fuel growth in the country's economy last year.
智慧型手機和電腦的強勁銷售，推動了該國去年的經濟成長。
fuel the fire: Their argument was almost over, but his rude comment only fueled the fire and made her even angrier.
他們的爭吵本來快結束了，但他無禮的話只是火上加油，讓她更生氣。
fuel inflation: Experts warn that printing too much money could fuel inflation and make daily goods much more expensive.
專家警告，印太多鈔票可能會助長通膨，讓日常用品變得貴得多。
fuel fears: News reports about the new virus fueled fears among parents, and many kept their children home from school.
有關新病毒的新聞報導加深了家長的恐懼，許多人讓孩子待在家不上學。
fulfill a dream: After saving money for ten years, my grandparents finally fulfilled a dream of traveling around Europe together.
存了十年錢之後，我的祖父母終於實現了一起環遊歐洲的夢想。
fulfill a promise: The mayor fulfilled a promise he made during the election by building a new park near our school.
市長在我們學校附近蓋了一座新公園，履行了他在選舉期間做出的承諾。
fulfill requirements: Students must fulfill requirements such as 30 hours of volunteer work before they can graduate from this school.
學生必須符合要求，例如完成三十小時的志工服務，才能從這所學校畢業。
fulfill one's potential: With the help of a good coach, the young swimmer was finally able to fulfill her potential and win gold.
在一位好教練的幫助下，這位年輕泳將終於得以發揮潛能，贏得金牌。
fulfill a role: Grandparents often fulfill a role as babysitters in Taiwan when both parents have to work full-time.
在台灣，當父母雙方都要全職工作時，祖父母常扮演保母的角色。
function as a kitchen: In our tiny student apartment, one corner of the living room has to function as a kitchen with a single hot plate.
在我們小小的學生公寓裡，客廳的一角只能靠一個電爐充當廚房。
function properly: My old laptop no longer functions properly; it shuts down by itself whenever I open more than two programs.
我的舊筆電已經無法正常運作；每當我開超過兩個程式，它就會自動關機。
function under pressure: Good doctors must be able to function under pressure, making quick decisions when a patient's life is in danger.
好醫生必須能在壓力下運作，在病人生命垂危時迅速做出決定。
fund research: The company promised to fund research on cleaner batteries by giving the university ten million dollars.
這家公司承諾捐給大學一千萬元，以資助更潔淨電池的研究。
fund a project: The city government agreed to fund a project to plant ten thousand trees, paying all of its costs.
市政府同意出資一項種植一萬棵樹的計畫，負擔其全部費用。
publicly funded: Most hospitals in this country are publicly funded, so patients pay very little when they see a doctor.
這個國家大多數醫院都是公費資助的，所以病人看醫生只需付很少的錢。
raise funds: Our class sold cookies and drinks at the school fair to raise funds for children in poor areas.
我們班在校園園遊會上賣餅乾和飲料，為偏鄉兒童募款。
furnish information: Witnesses were asked to furnish information about the car accident so the police could find the driver who escaped.
目擊者被要求提供有關這起車禍的資訊，好讓警方找到逃逸的駕駛。
furnish evidence: If you want your money back, you must furnish evidence, such as a receipt, showing that you bought it here.
如果你想退款，就必須提供證據，例如收據，證明你是在這裡買的。
furnish a room: My parents bought a desk, a bed, and some shelves to furnish a room for my grandmother when she moved in.
我奶奶搬來同住時，我爸媽買了書桌、床和一些層架，為她的房間添家具。
furnish a reason: If you miss the final exam, you must furnish a reason, such as a doctor's note, to take it again.
如果你錯過期末考，就必須提出理由，例如醫生證明，才能補考。
